title: BreakBias
summary: BreakBias is my innovation-training program — eight structured tools for thinking past the biases that block ideation. Delivered to individuals, teams, and organizations, including Microsoft, Tiffany, Havas, Dentsu, and Google.
thesis: Individuals, teams, and organizations can learn to think past the cognitive biases that block innovation through a structured, repeatable practice — a practical, reproducible alternative to traditional brainstorming.
experiment: Built an 8-tool innovation-training master course, with workshops for 3 audiences (individuals, teams, organizations), delivered online and in-person.
question: Have you considered how to think about ideas — not just what to think about?
